advancements.guhs.techniek.root.title: Guh Technology
advancements.guhs.techniek.root.descript: Make a Guh Wheel, Guh Wire or a Guh Oven: chonk power does the rest. Nyeg, it works all by itself!
structure.guhs.oude_guhrad_centrale.tool: An old power plant where five guhs are still running their laps, with the Inventor Guh and his practice hall (Guhbarbecuether)
block.guhs.grote_knabbelmachine.lore: The little tray under its mouth. Whoever finishes building it gets one perfect nibble out of it every day
block.guhs.techquest_knabbelmachine_deel: Piece of the Great Nibble Machine
block.guhs.knabbelmachine_beeldje.lore: The Great Nibble Machine, only tiny. Click it and it nibbles
item.guhs.perfecte_knabbel.lore: Crispy, cheesy and still warm. Only one a day comes out of the Great Nibble Machine
item.guhs.techquest_recept_saus.lore: For the Sauce Pump, the Sauce Vat, the Auto Brewer, the Auto Fryer, the Grill Coal Press and the Blub Stove
item.guhs.techquest_recept_machines.lore: For the Nibbler, the Placer, the Tinker Machine and the Drawing Table
item.guhs.techquest_recept_bezorg.lore: For the Scooter Station and the Stop Posts
item.guhs.techquest_recept.blijft: Stays in the crafting grid: one card is enough forever
item.guhs.techquest_oefenknabbel.lore: Made of cardboard, for the tubes of the practice hall. Do not eat: tastes like box
item.guhs.techquest_oefenrommel.lore: Junk from the practice hall. A Filter Piece is supposed to stop this
gui.guhs.titels.hint.knabbelmachinist: Finish building something very big at the Inventor Guh's
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.draad.gema: The oven is awake! Setup 1 works
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.te_zwaar.g: The wheel can handle it again! Setup 2 works
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.buis.gemaa: The nibbles are rolling the right way! Setup 3 works
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.filter.gem: The filter only lets nibbles through now! Setup 4 works
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.filter.pap: The paper wads that already got through are swept back into the first barrel by the Inventor Guh
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.saus.gemaa: There's sauce in the vat! Setup 5 works
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.draad.verd: Setup 1 is done. On to setup 2, the bay next door!
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.te_zwaar.v: Setup 2 is done. The Inventor Guh wants a word: he needs salt
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.buis.verde: Setup 3 is done. On to setup 4: the filter
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.filter.ver: Setup 4 is done. On to setup 5: the sauce (ask the Inventor Guh for a Sauce Hose)
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.saus.verde: Setup 5 is done: the whole practice hall works! Go tell the Inventor Guh
gui.guhs.techquest.opstelling.stuk: (A setup breaks again by itself once everyone has wandered off: the next player wants to practice too, nyeg.)
gui.guhs.techquest.machine.eerst: An empty little tray. The Inventor Guh must have plans for this
gui.guhs.techquest.machine.plan: Something very big is going here. Just ask the Inventor Guh
gui.guhs.techquest.machine.bezig: Your Great Nibble Machine isn't finished yet (%s of the %s steps). Bring the Inventor Guh what he needs
gui.guhs.techquest.machine.morgen: The little tray is empty. Tomorrow there'll be another perfect nibble, nyeg
gui.guhs.techquest.machine.knabbel: A perfect nibble! Still warm. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.techquest.beloning.knabbel: One perfect nibble every day from your very own Great Nibble Machine
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.hallo1: Nyeg! A visitor! Welcome to the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant. Five old guhs have been running their laps here for ages, and I am the Inventor Guh.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.hallo2: But my practice hall... all broken! Somebody fiddled with every little button. (Me. It was me.) Will you help me fix the five setups? You'll learn how chonk power works right away. Here, two pieces of Guh Wire!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.hint.draa: Go to setup 1 in the practice hall and put Guh Wire in the gap (the yellow tile)
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.draad: Setup 1: the wheel is running, the oven is asleep. In between, a piece of Guh Wire is missing. Put it on the yellow tile and look at the oven: you'll read right away how much chonk power the setup uses.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.draad_wee: Lost your Guh Wire? Nyeg. Here, another one. Don't eat it, it tastes like zaps.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.te_zwaar: Setup 2: one wheel gives 10 chonk power, but two ovens and a Chonk Mill ask for 15. Too heavy, and then EVERYTHING stands still. Snip a wire at the red wool: take one machine off.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.zout: For the tubes I need salt: %2$s salt crystals. You have %1$s right now. Find the Salt Crystal Mine, or salt crystal ore in the rocks, nyeg!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.zout_dank: Salt! Wahoog! That's what tubes, filters and sensors are made of. Come along, the salt department: setup 3.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.hint.buis: Setup 3: sneak and click the Direction Piece with an empty hand, and it flips around
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.buis: Setup 3: the nibbles have to go from the full barrel to the empty one, but the Direction Piece is pointing backwards. Sneak and click it with an empty hand: then it flips around. (Practice nibbles are made of cardboard. Do not eat. I tried.)
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.filter: Setup 4: the barrel holds practice nibbles AND paper wads. The Filter Piece should only let nibbles through, but it's set wrong: the nibble is on its list, with 'all except' next to it. So only the paper rolls through! Click it and set it to 'only these'.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.saus: Setup 5, the tastiest one: the Sauce Pump slurps up cheese sauce, but between the pump and the Sauce Vat a piece of Sauce Hose is missing. Put it on the yellow tile and wait until there's a bucket of sauce in the vat.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.slang: Here's a Sauce Hose. My last one. Well, my last one for today.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.klaar1: WAHOOG! The whole practice hall is working again! You get chonk power better than my last assistant. (That was a nibble.)
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.klaar2: This is for you: the Bottomless Nibble Belly for your Bank Guh, and my three recipe cards. With those you can tinker together pumps, Nibblers, a Delivery Guhling... Look in your quest book under Guh Technology!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.hint.wink: Lost a card? Sneak and click the Inventor Guh: he'll sell them again
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.tip0: A happy guh runs faster. Let him lie on a Cuddle Generator for a bit first, nyeg!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.tip1: Too heavy is too heavy: then everything stands still. Look at a wire and you'll read what's wrong.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.tip2: A Delivery Guhling only picks up what he can also drop off somewhere. Smarter than me, to be honest.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.tip3: I'm working on something big. It has ears. That's all I'm saying. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.eerst_: I have a plan for the biggest machine ever, but its heart has to be a glowstar. Only the Burnt Mika has one. Beat him first (he's in the Mika Grill Palace), then we'll talk!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.plan1: You beat the Burnt Mika?! Then it's time. Look at the platform: that's where we're building THE GREAT NIBBLE MACHINE. A guh made of copper, nine blocks tall, that makes one perfect nibble every day.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.plan2: I need mountains of stuff for it. So much that you'll have to build a factory for it, nyeg. Feel free to bring it in portions: I count everything. And only you see your machine grow.
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.dank: Thank you! That was %s of them. I counted. Twice.
First the foundation. For that I need stone and wood, lots and lots:
The foundation is down! Straight, sturdy and almost level. Wahoog!
Now the boiler. I fire it with grill coal, and I grease the weld seams with fried cheese nibbles:
The boiler is up! It's already bubbling a little. Or that was my tummy.
The belly. Flour goes in there, and a whole tangle of Guh Wire for nerves:
The belly is in, chimneys and all! It's rumbling. It's supposed to.
The snoot! I need glass for his eyes, and Guh Potions to get the enamel nice and pink:
He has a snoot! And ears! Look at that, he's still asleep. Nyeg, how sweet.
The last thing: his heart. A glowstar. And nibbles, for his very first bite:
The heart is glowing... his eyes are opening...
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.af1: HE'S NIBBLING! WAHOOG! The Great Nibble Machine is alive! Look at him chew!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.af2: Every day there'll be one perfect nibble in the little tray, just for you. And this statuette is for your shelf. From now on you're a real Nibble Machinist!
quest.guhs.techquest.uitvinder.km.knabbe: Psst: there's a perfect nibble waiting for you in the machine's little tray. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.uitleg: In the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant five old guhs are still running their laps, but the Inventor Guh's practice hall is in ruins. Whoever fixes the five setups will understand how chonk power works.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.0: Find the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant and talk to the Inventor Guh in his workshop.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.0: The Old Guh Wheel Power Plant in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.1: Setup 1: put Guh Wire in the gap between the wheel and the Guh Oven (the yellow tile).
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.1: The practice hall of the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.2: Setup 2: three machines on one wheel is too much. Snip a wire at the red wool.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.2: The practice hall of the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.3: Bring the Inventor Guh 4 salt crystals (from the Salt Crystal Mine or from salt crystal ore).
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.4: Setup 3: sneak and click the Direction Piece with an empty hand, so it flips around.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.4: The practice hall of the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.5: Setup 4: click the Filter Piece and switch it from 'all except' to 'only these'.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.5: The practice hall of the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.6: Setup 5: put the Sauce Hose in the gap between the pump and the Sauce Vat and wait for the sauce.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.6: The practice hall of the Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.7: Tell the Inventor Guh that the whole practice hall is working again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.nu.klaar: The practice hall is working again. With the recipe cards you can make the sauce machines: look in your quest book under Guh Technology.
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.waar.klaar: The Old Guh Wheel Power Plant in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.kort.1: Setup 1: put Guh Wire in the gap
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.kort.3: Bring 4 salt crystals to the Inventor Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.kort.5: Setup 4: set the Filter Piece to 'only these'
gui.guhs.verhalen.techniek.kort.6: Setup 5: put the Sauce Hose in the gap
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.uitleg: The Inventor Guh wants to build the biggest machine ever: a guh made of copper that makes one perfect nibble every day. He needs so much stuff for it that you'll have to build a factory. Every player builds their own machine.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.0: Beat the Burnt Mika (in the Mika Grill Palace) and then talk to the Inventor Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.waar.0: The Old Guh Wheel Power Plant in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.1: Bring the Inventor Guh 256 stones (cobblestone, blackstone or deepslate) and 128 logs. Portions are fine: he counts everything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.2: Bring the Inventor Guh 96 grill coal and 128 fried cheese nibbles. Portions are fine: he counts everything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.3: Bring the Inventor Guh 128 nibble flour and 64 Guh Wire. Portions are fine: he counts everything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.4: Bring the Inventor Guh 12 Guh Potions (any you like) and 128 glass. Portions are fine: he counts everything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.5: Bring the Inventor Guh 1 glowstar and 256 cheese nibbles. Portions are fine: he counts everything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.nu.klaa: The Great Nibble Machine is nibbling! Every day there's one perfect nibble for you in the little tray under its mouth.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.waar.kl: The Old Guh Wheel Power Plant in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.kort.0: Beat the Burnt Mika and talk to the Inventor Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.kort.2: Boiler: bring grill coal and fried cheese nibbles
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.kort.3: Belly: bring nibble flour and Guh Wire
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.kort.4: Snoot: bring Guh Potions and glass
gui.guhs.verhalen.knabbelmachine.kort.5: Heart: bring a glowstar and cheese nibbles
